reviews.title: Scam alert
reviews.text:
$10/week.  That’s the definition of a scam.  The author claims free measuring… I could not find a way to load and use for free.  I’m sure there is some way to do it if you know the secret.  It demands agreeing to $10/week. Want to bet it’s nearly impossible to find how to cancel before ’trial’ week is over. Avoid this scammer.  

To the author:  Don’t bother replying, God blessed you with skills to make a great app, use those skills and make an honest dollar by asking for reasonable reconciliation for your product. In no world is $10/week justified.  Your mother would be embarrassed if one of her friends downloaded your app.

reviews.title: That’s weird
reviews.text: Tried to use this program to measure the band-width (like 44mm) to verify it with the right size. The Freeform point point measurement tool was really cludgy, unintuitive and was all over the place. I switched over to Manuel tape measure on screen and it was off by at least 7 mm… meaning it made the band look like it was a 32mm when it was closer to being a 40mm. Not good.
